أحتفظ (form VIII)
# أَحْتَفِظُ (ʔaḥtafiẓu) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.ðˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
# أُحْتَفَظُ (ʔuḥtafaẓu) /ʔuħ.ta.fa.ðˤu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
# أَحْتَفِظَ (ʔaḥtafiẓa) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.ðˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
# أُحْتَفَظَ (ʔuḥtafaẓa) /ʔuħ.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
